prisoner-bed-before-fight: A threat letter is live, no hostiles yet, and there is no prisoner bed.

Fallback: beds refuses (no room) -> game_set cmd shelter first, then retry once.
Owner: "Prisoner bed exists BEFORE any fight".
mine-before-wall: A wall blueprint touches unmined rock.
Sequence: game_apply_architect_designator Cancel on that wall section -> Mine the explored inside (small block) -> re-lay the wall after.
Fallback: rock is fogged -> leave it and wall elsewhere; never Mine fogged rock.

Look: game_get_cell_info an intact wall cell next to the gap -> copy its defName.
Sequence: outer one-cell gap = door; other gaps = the same wall def (game_select_architect_designator + game_click_cell).
Fallback: def not offered -> stone wall now, swap later; never the first embrasure the list offers.
Never furniture in the inner lane. Done = wall_gaps 0 (standing).
Owner: "wtf why u putting walls upganets and replacing embrasures that wont work fix those walls".
terraform-water-first: Water or mud sits inside the camp, or a farm plot is on sand/gravel/rock.
Sequence: Cancel blueprints on water (game_apply_architect_designator Cancel) -> terraform to soil (game_select_architect_designator + game_drag_cell) -> sow after.
Fallback: designator missing -> list_architect_designators, search 'terraform'; never wall the water.
Done = ladder_set mark terraform_done true (latch terraform_water_first_done).
Owner: "dont forget terriforming for soil plots".

Sequence: PlantsCut the 3-wide band (game_set cmd chop for trees) -> stone floor ring FIREBREAK_WIDTH wide (game_select_architect_designator + game_drag_cell).

rung-2-power-and-cold: Camp is stable and fed; build the generator yard.
Research Electricity -> Air conditioning (research tab search box).
WoodFiredGenerator: game_select_architect_designator + game_click_cell each slot, one row OUTSIDE rooms, INSIDE the wall, unroofed.
Generators in a room: Reinstall gizmo -> yard. One conduit string to every consumer.
Cooler in the food wall, red side out; lamps, not torches.
Fallback: placement refused/cancelled -> ladder_set mark generator_tried true (2 -> power-generators-fallback).
Done = power_generators >= 2 -> ladder_set mark power_row_built true.

power-generators-fallback: reply_owner once: one mouse pass on the generator yard row please; unity_say a clean line to chat.
Fallback: none -- do not retry the placement.

power-every-consumer: Look: game_get_cells_info round it for the nearest conduit.
Sequence: game_select_architect_designator PowerConduit (HiddenConduit indoors) + game_drag_cell ONE run to it.
Fallback: no grid nearby -> power-generation-margin first; never an island.
Done = unpowered_consumers 0 -> ladder_set mark power_wired true.
Owner: "you got shit without power need conduit, ive told you this already!!!!".
power-generation-margin: Sequence: geothermal on a geyser / watermill / solar in the yard first (game_select_architect_designator + game_click_cell), wood-fired last; batteries for nights.
Fallback: research missing -> one more WoodFiredGenerator in the yard.
Owner: "u need better power not 10000 wood gens".
power-alternate: Solar is researched and the grid runs on wood only.
Sequence: game_select_architect_designator SolarGenerator; game_click_cell inside the wall under sky; conduit to the grid.
Fallback: no open sky cell -> wind turbine; geothermal on a steam geyser later.
Owner: "your gonna need some alternate power".
battery-room: Sequence: stone room by the yard, roofed -> Battery rows (game_select_architect_designator Battery + game_click_cell) with an aisle to each -> conduit under every battery.
Fallback: steel short -> build the room, batteries next pass.
Done = ladder_set mark battery_room_done true (latch battery_room_done).
Owner: "battery room need redesign and path to all batteryies" / "and ur gonna need LOTS OF BATTERIES!".
coolers-and-vents: Sequence: cooler in its outer wall, red side outdoors (game_select_architect_designator Cooler + game_click_cell, Q to rotate); vents for halls.

electric-lights: Sequence: standing lamp beside each torch (game_select_architect_designator StandingLamp + game_click_cell), conduit, deconstruct the torch.

Fallback: steel/stone short -> stone wall now, embrasure later.

Never wall every route: raiders dig if nothing is open.
Done = ladder_set mark killbox_done true (latch killbox_funnel_done).
